# Providence Pediatric Dentistry

> A comprehensive pediatric dental practice in Providence, RI led by Dr. Thomas and Dr. Farisa Mulvey, offering specialized care for children including preventive, restorative, and special needs dentistry.

Providence Pediatric Dentistry provides full-spectrum dental services for children with a focus on preventive care, comfort, and accessibility. The practice follows American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry and American Dental Association guidelines to ensure the highest standards of pediatric oral health care.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Preventive Care
- Restorative Dentistry

- Special Needs Patient Care

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.drmulvey.com/services): Overview of pediatric dentistry services including preventive, restorative, and special needs care
- [Children's Dentistry](https://www.drmulvey.com/services/childrens-dentistry): Children's dental care with fluoride treatment and dental sealants
- [Dental Cleanings and Exams](https://www.drmulvey.com/services/dental-cleanings-and-exams): Professional dental cleanings and preventive exams following ADA recommendations
- [Restorative Dentistry](https://www.drmulvey.com/services/restorative-dentistry): Restorative dentistry services including bonding, fillings, and dental crowns
- [Composite Fillings](https://www.drmulvey.com/services/composite-fillings): Composite resin fillings for cavity treatment and tooth decay protection
- [Special Needs Patient Care](https://www.drmulvey.com/services/special-needs-patient-care): Compassionate special needs dental care with accessibility accommodations

## Specialized Treatments

- [Periodontics](https://www.drmulvey.com/services/periodontics): Periodontal therapy for gum disease treatment including gingivitis and periodontitis
- [Athletic Mouth Guards](https://www.drmulvey.com/services/athletic-mouth-guards): Custom athletic mouth guards for sports injury prevention in children
- [Dental Hygiene Education](https://www.drmulvey.com/services/dental-hygiene-education): Dental hygiene education and oral health tips for children in Providence, RI
